name: Muting a process
goal: The main feature of the App Muter is to mute an application.

approach.text: The following source gave me a good starting point on muting a process: <<source Simon Mourier. (2013, January 14). Controlling Volume mixer. Stack Overflow. Retrieved February 27, 2025, from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/14306048/controlling-volume-mixer/14322736#14322736>>. However, this solution seemed very dragged out, so I could probably compact it a little bit.
While validating the solution iteratively, I refactored the code bit by bit.
I gave the feature several tests while during the development.

normalLearnings: I can mute specific processes and entire applications.
result: The code to achieve the result is shown here:<<image 1.png>>Some applications use multiple processes which all needed to be muted. The result can be seen here:<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/3nHEMH74y38>>
validation: The functionality works on every program.
contribution: Instead of having to open the volume mixer, searching and muting an application, I am now able to mute applications with a simple keybind.
